places.name: Manuel Antonio National Park
places.ai_summary: Manuel Antonio National Park is a biodiverse haven featuring pristine beaches, lush rainforests, and abundant wildlife, including monkeys, sloths, and exotic birds. It's one of Costa Rica's most popular destinations.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide to spot wildlife and learn about the park's ecosystem.
places.address: Manuel Antonio, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Espadilla Beach
places.ai_summary: Espadilla Beach is a stunning stretch of golden sand located near Manuel Antonio National Park. It's perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying water sports like surfing and kayaking.
places.place_tip: Rent a beach chair and umbrella for a relaxing day by the sea.
places.address: Espadilla Beach, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Biesanz Beach
places.ai_summary: Biesanz Beach is a secluded cove with calm waters, ideal for snorkeling and swimming. Surrounded by lush greenery, it's a hidden gem for those seeking tranquility.
places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the underwater life.
places.address: Biesanz Beach, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Cathedral Point Trail
places.ai_summary: Cathedral Point Trail is a scenic hiking trail in Manuel Antonio, leading to a viewpoint with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and the surrounding rainforest. The trail is named for the cathedral-like rock formations along the way.
places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and bring water for the hike.
places.address: Cathedral Point Trail, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Playa Manuel Antonio Hike
places.ai_summary: The Playa Manuel Antonio Hike is a popular trail that takes you through lush rainforest and offers stunning views of the coastline. The hike ends at the beautiful Manuel Antonio Beach.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Manuel Antonio National Park for a full day of exploration.
places.address: Playa Manuel Antonio Hike, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Quepos Marina Pez Vela
places.ai_summary: Quepos Marina Pez Vela is a modern marina offering a range of services for boaters and visitors. It's a great place to enjoy fresh seafood, shop for souvenirs, and take in the beautiful views of the marina and the Pacific Ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual businesses within the marina.

places.place_tip: Try the ceviche at one of the marina restaurants.
places.address: Quepos Marina Pez Vela, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Rainmaker Conservation Project
places.ai_summary: The Rainmaker Conservation Project is a private reserve that offers a unique opportunity to experience Costa Rica's rainforest up close. The reserve features hiking trails, waterfalls, and a canopy suspension bridge.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and be prepared for a moderate hike.
places.address: Rainmaker Conservation Project, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Damas Island Mangrove Kayak Tour
places.ai_summary: The Damas Island Mangrove Kayak Tour is an eco-friendly tour that takes you through the mangroves of Damas Island. It's a great way to see wildlife such as crocodiles, monkeys, and a variety of bird species.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching.
places.address: Damas Island, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
places.ai_summary: The Sunset Catamaran Cruise is a popular tour that offers a relaxing way to enjoy the stunning sunsets of Costa Rica's Pacific coast. The cruise typically includes snorkeling, swimming, and a chance to see dolphins and other marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Check with local operators for schedule.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket for the evening breeze.
places.address: Quepos Marina Pez Vela, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Parasailing & Jet Ski Tours
places.ai_summary: Parasailing & Jet Ski Tours offer an adrenaline-pumping way to experience the beauty of Manuel Antonio from the air and sea. Enjoy breathtaking views while soaring above the coastline or speeding across the water.
places.place_tip: Wear swimwear and bring a towel.
places.address: Quepos Marina Pez Vela, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Sloth Walks (Guided)
places.ai_summary: Sloth Walks (Guided) offer a unique opportunity to see sloths in their natural habitat. These guided tours take you through the rainforest where you can learn about sloths and other wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to see sloths is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and be patient for sloth sightings.
places.address: Sloth Walks, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: El Avión Restaurant & Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: El Avión Restaurant & Viewpoint is a unique dining spot built around a retired Fairchild FH-227 aircraft. The restaurant offers stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and a diverse menu featuring local and international cuisine.
places.place_tip: Try the seafood dishes and enjoy a cocktail at sunset.
places.address: El Avión, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Nauyaca Waterfalls (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: Nauyaca Waterfalls is a stunning two-tiered waterfall located near Dominical, Costa Rica. The falls are accessible by a scenic hike or horseback ride, and they offer a refreshing swimming hole.
places.place_tip: Bring water shoes for swimming at the falls.
places.address: Nauyaca Waterfalls, San Isidro de El General, Costa Rica

places.name: Rafting Savegre River
places.ai_summary: Rafting Savegre River is an exhilarating adventure that takes you through the stunning landscapes of Costa Rica's Savegre River. The river is known for its clear waters and diverse wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Check with local operators for schedule.

places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and a towel.
places.address: Savegre River, Costa Rica

places.name: ATV Jungle Tour
places.ai_summary: The ATV Jungle Tour is an exciting adventure that takes you through the jungles and beaches of Manuel Antonio. It's a great way to explore the area and enjoy some adrenaline-pumping fun.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and closed-toe shoes.
places.address: ATV Jungle Tour, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: MidWorld Adventure Park
places.ai_summary: MidWorld Adventure Park is an eco-adventure park that offers a variety of activities including zip-lining, ATV tours, and a butterfly garden. It's a great place for families and adventure seekers.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the butterfly garden and the zip-line tour.
places.address: MidWorld Adventure Park, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Manuel Antonio Surf Lessons
places.ai_summary: Manuel Antonio Surf Lessons offers a fun and exciting way to learn how to surf in one of Costa Rica's top surf destinations. The lessons are suitable for all levels, from beginners to advanced surfers.
places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and a hat for sun protection.
places.address: Manuel Antonio Surf Lessons, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica

places.ai_summary: The Rainforest Spa Retreat offers a unique wellness experience in the heart of the rainforest. Enjoy a range of spa treatments and therapies surrounded by the sounds and sights of nature.
places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but especially nice after a day of hiking or surfing
places.place_tip: Try the chocolate therapy treatment for a unique experience.

places.ai_summary: The Titi Canopy Zipline is an exhilarating zip-line tour that takes you high above the rainforest canopy. It's a great way to experience the beauty of the rainforest and see wildlife from a different perspective.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and closed-toe shoes.

places.name: Nighttime Wildlife Walk
places.ai_summary: The Nighttime Wildlife Walk is a guided tour that takes you through the rainforest at night. It's a unique opportunity to see nocturnal animals and learn about the rainforest ecosystem.
places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but especially interesting during the rainy season
places.place_tip: Bring a flashlight and be prepared for wet conditions.
places.address: Nighttime Wildlife Walk, Puntarenas Province, Costa Rica
